findings.description: User input passed directly to database query without parameterization. SQL injection risk.
findings.suggested_fix: Use parameterized queries via the repository pattern prescribed in ADR-005.

findings.description: 3 functions missing error handling at I/O boundaries (fetchProfile, updateProfile, deleteProfile).
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap each I/O call in try/catch and return Result<T, E> as established in prior tasks.

findings.description: Magic number 86400 used for cache TTL without named constant.
findings.suggested_fix: Extract to a named constant CACHE_TTL_SECONDS = 86400.

commendations: Clean separation of route handler and business logic.
Proper use of discriminated unions for profile state.
